# Get Ready for a Chaotic Cleaning Adventure Like No Other in Be a Vacuum!

**Messy Rooms, Clean Fun**

Control your vacuum in a colorful, cartoon-styled home and suck up everything in your path! Explore rooms, clean up messes, and watch your vacuum’s power grow.

[media]

**Suck It Up, Toss It Around!**

Collect everyday objects like fruits and toys with your vacuum, then launch them as projectiles! Aim at walls and windows to create chaos and have fun in your vibrant home environment.

[media]

**Toss Granny Into Chaos!!**

Engage in hilarious, physics-based mayhem as you use everyday items to toss and disrupt the environment! Watch as Granny  tumble and furniture flies in this slapstick-filled VR adventure.

[media]

**Clean & Chaos!**

Grab fruits, toys, and eggs with your vacuum, then launch them across the room! Watch as everything tumbles and creates hilarious, unpredictable chaos in the living room.
